description: Voting Village at DEF CON 26 covers election security, voting machine vulnerabilities, and election infrastructure defenses. The talks explore election threats and solutions, voting machine forensics, auditing procedures, state and local election security perspectives, and trustworthy election systems.

talks.title: Defending Election Security A National Security Priority
talks.teaser: Election security as a national security priority: threats, vulnerabilities, and defensive strategies.

talks.title: State, Local Perspectives on Election Security
talks.teaser: State and local perspectives on securing election systems and managing election security risks.

talks.title: Lightning Talk A Crash Course on Election Security
talks.teaser: Rapid overview of election security fundamentals, risks, and key security concepts.

talks.title: Mechanics and Pitfalls of Auditing with Scanners
talks.teaser: Challenges and methodologies for auditing voting systems using security scanning tools.

talks.title: Trustworthy Elections
talks.teaser: Building trustworthy election systems through security principles and verification methods.

talks.title: Recap of Voting Village 2017  Lessons Learned
talks.teaser: Summary of voting security research from 2017 and key lessons for future election security.

talks.title: Election Security Threats and Solutions
talks.teaser: Overview of election security threats facing voting systems and practical security solutions.

talks.title: Return of Software Vulns in Brazilian Voting Machines
talks.teaser: Analysis of software vulnerabilities and security issues in Brazilian electronic voting machines.

talks.title: A Comprehensive Forensic Analysis of WINVote Voting
talks.teaser: Detailed forensic analysis of security vulnerabilities and design flaws in WINVote voting machines.
